items.label: Versatile Combination Use
items.value: Folding sofa can be converted into a sofa bed. The creative combination of two sofas can provide a spacious resting area, and different spatial configurations can be combined according to needs, increasing the diversity and fun of indoor decoration

items.label: L-Shaped Design
items.value: The L-shaped foam armrest design can be used as a headrest or armrest, enhancing the versatility of the sofa bed. The L-shaped armrest adopts a buckle design to ensure a stable connection with the folding sofa

items: The tufting craft can effectively stabilize the shredded foam filling, ensuring even distribution of sofa support force

items.label: Durable Fabric
items.value: Crafted from premium corded fabric, this material offers a unique visual and tactile experience, elevating the ambiance of your living space.

items.label: Important Note
items.value: The sofa bed is compressed and vacuum-sealed to reduce space and carbon dioxide emissions during shipping. Upon unpacking, allow the sofa bed to breathe for 48 hours to regain its original shape and size
